digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, operator-attested criterion, measurement provenance verification
propositions: Attestations satisfying the existing operator-attested contract can escape gate review by omitting measurement context: which environment the measurement was taken in, under which principal, at what privilege relative to production, and what instrument (live-call vs simulation vs static-analysis) produced it.

Two real escapes occurred in run 061c-ecd1-8967-4a76: bedrock measurements taken in account 579718921998/us-east-2 were recorded as settled for work targeting 896586841071/us-east-1, and live bedrock:Converse calls under bedrock:* privilege were offered as validation of a scoped bedrock:InvokeModel grant that would have failed in production.

The amendment to the operator-attested evidence contract must extend with four required provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) as a continuation line under each [operator-attested] item, with specific literal values and a one-line justification, and must be enforceable deterministically (no LLM) for presence and shape while reserving semantic judgement (authorization-claim detection, repo-anchored contradiction finding) to an agentic LLM criterion.

A deterministic check must flag any [operator-attested] criterion lacking any of the four provenance fields or containing placeholder values (empty, TBD, TODO, N/A, ?, -, angle-bracketed), without making judgement about correctness; an LLM criterion must then evaluate declared environment against repo infrastructure anchors, privilege posture against criterion intent, and instrument type against authorization-vs-non-authorization claims.

The instrument field is structurally independent of privilege_posture: a simulation or static-analysis instrument answering authorization questions (like simulate-principal-policy) remains evidence-deficient even when declared production-equivalent, because it checks policy text not API behavior, making it unable to catch escape 2b (Converse policy vs API discrepancy).

The new criterion must ship advisory-only on first landing, activate through .rebar/ project overlay not shipped defaults (leaving all cross-client contract text byte-identical), and include corpus-replay calibration data before any promotion to blocking.
